sources.title: pairs function - RDocumentation
sources.snippet: The graphical parameter oma will be set by pairs.default unless supplied as an argument. A panel function should not attempt to start a new plot, but just plot within a given coordinate system: thus plot and boxplot are not panel functions. By default, missing values are passed to the panel functions and will often be ignored within a panel.
